mechanism.statement: Measured fixed native affine54 prototype improves local FFN approximation and physical warm runtime but fails the two-source video-quality goal. Local teacher SSE is not sufficient for full-video acceptance. Algebraic GELU parity/full-residual identity does not make fixed54 truncated BF16/QDQ approximation exact, and the prototype failure does not establish impossibility of the affine/nonlinear-residual family.

Truncation to selected full groups, fitted readout and BF16 fold create approximation. Operator+prefix signed total: [fS(xS)-fD(xS)]+[fD(xS)-fD(xD)], with subsequent gate/step finite effects unresolved.

countermechanism.statement: Either the local teacher-SSE objective necessarily causes the failure, or the entire affine/residual family is structurally incapable of a video-quality/speed tradeoff.
countermechanism.prediction: That statement would require causal intervention or family-level lower bound, neither present. Native same-input residual may dominate, student-prefix error may grow, or signed suffix and scheduler response may dominate; these alternatives predict different paired site and downstream signatures.

discriminator: Audit packed native same-input numerical error first; in separately authorized native scope collect actual all40x4 paired teacher/student FFN and postgate signed states, then preregister a limited real suffix/hybrid functional test if needed. In parallel, allow unrelated information/function/physical-compute mechanisms without making affine54 rescue a default task.
